sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the details you give us when you register as a nominee, vote, buy tickets, apply to join the committee or contact us — for example your name, email address and phone number.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: We use your details to run OGA: to process votes and ticket orders, manage nominee accounts, respond to enquiries and send important event updates.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Payments are handled by our payment provider. We do not store your card details.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can contact us to ask about, correct or delete your information.

sections.heading: Using this site
sections.body: By using this site you agree to use it fairly and lawfully, and not to interfere with voting, ticketing or other users.

sections.heading: Voting
sections.body: Votes are counted after payment is verified. Attempts to manipulate results may lead to votes being removed.

sections.heading: Tickets
sections.body: Each ticket carries a unique code that can be scanned once at the gate.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. The date at the top shows when they last changed.
